# Three PARKED equity candidates on the unused 2010-01 → 2019-09 holdout (2026-09-29)

## Pre-registration (written BEFORE any holdout number was computed; do not edit this section after the results)

**Why.** Audit step 3 item 2 (`audit_top_down_2026-09-25.md` List A #2). Three rows sat near the bar on the 2019-10 →
2026 liquid panel and were parked for a 2027 forward lockbox. `data/cache/liquid_panel_2009.parquet` (1,728 names,
2009-01 → 2026-09) gives an **out-of-time** period nobody has used for them. The fourth row of that item (breakout-
activity gate) already ran on 2026-09-27 and reversed (`activity_gate_holdout_2026-09-27.md`).

**Everything is frozen from the original.** Same signal builders, same exits, same controls, same stat; only the panel
and the window change. The exit arm of each row is fixed to the one that produced its in-sample t (in-sample it was
the best of 5 arms; on the holdout there is no arm choice, so no search charge).

| test | original (2019-10 → 2026) | signal (unchanged code) | trade | PRIMARY stat on the holdout |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **H1 earnings drift good+MUTED** | vs xname **t 3.17** (t1R), p_search 0.002, 8/8 yrs | `run_ledger_rerun.earnings_patterns` "good+MUTED": reaction day up, RVOL ≥ 1.5, upper half of range, move ≤ 4%; enter next open | hold 10, stop = 3-day low | harness paired edge, arm **t1R**, control **xname** |
| **H2 house breakout inside HYB-A** | vs post **t 4.15** (stop_hold), p 0.0015 | `run_precision_tier_control.build` breakouts ∧ `run_universe_test.build_masks` HYB-A (prior-close membership) | close entry, stop = day low, hold 60 | harness paired edge, arm **stop_hold**, control **post** |
| **H3 HYB-B universe selection** | ADR-matched 20d excess **+1.79%, t 2.60** | HYB-B mask (TT core, ADDV ≥ $100M, ADR ≥ 4%), prior-close membership | random member, 20 sessions | per-date ADR-decile-matched 20d excess vs the eligible panel, non-overlapping dates, ≥ 5 members (`run_hybb_neighbourhood.matched`, cell 4.0 / $100M) |

**Window.** Signal / formation dates 2010-01-01 → 2019-09-30 (H3's masks need 252 sessions, so its first valid date is
early 2010). Trades that start before 2019-10 may finish after it; entry date is what counts.

**Bar (each test judged alone).** Primary stat **> 0 with t ≥ 3**, **both halves positive** (split 2015-01-01), and
positive in **a majority of years**. Pass → SUPPORTED out of time (still not certified: survivor panel). Fail → the
PARKED row is downgraded (NULL if the sign holds but t < 2; RETRACTED if it reverses).

**Reported, not in the bar:** the other control (H1 post, H2 xname), the ema20 arm, raw (unmatched) excess for H3,
per-year, and the harness p_search.

**Known limits.** `liquid_panel_2009` is today's liquid names → survivor-biased; this flatters every long arm alike and
the controls come from the same panel, so paired/matched stats are less affected than raw means. The earnings table
is thinner before 2015 (394 reports in 2010 vs ~1,000 now). The harness t is date-clustered. Local run.
